name: sevdesk
description: Unofficial sevdesk MCP server (read-only by default) plus a skill for invoices, vouchers, contacts and open items. The API token comes from the system keychain or SEVDESK_API_TOKEN, never from this plugin.

mode.title: sevdesk access mode
mode.description: read: only reading tools. write: also drafts, contacts, payments and status changes, each status change or booking with a preview and confirmation. full: also irreversible actions, which additionally need SEVDESK_ENABLE_TOOLS in your environment.
